feedback.description: Brightness: Warm and round; Attack and sustain: Short pluck; Texture: Buzzy sawtooth; Movement: Stable; Space: Dry and close.

top_matches.label: Warm and round
top_matches.text: A warm, round and mellow synthesizer tone.

top_matches.label: Dark and soft
top_matches.text: A dark, soft and low-pass filtered synthesizer tone.

top_matches.label: Bright and sharp
top_matches.text: A bright, sharp synthesizer tone with strong high frequency harmonics.

top_matches.label: Short pluck
top_matches.text: A short plucked synthesizer note with a sharp attack and quick decay.

top_matches.label: Slow swell
top_matches.text: A soft synthesizer pad that swells in slowly and fades out gradually.

top_matches.label: Steady sustain
top_matches.text: A steady sustained synthesizer note with a constant volume.

top_matches.label: Buzzy sawtooth
top_matches.text: A buzzy sawtooth synthesizer sound with rich harmonics.

top_matches.label: Metallic bell
top_matches.text: A metallic bell-like synthesizer sound with ringing inharmonic overtones.

top_matches.label: Clean and smooth
top_matches.text: A clean smooth pure sine-like musical tone with few harmonics.

top_matches.label: Stable
top_matches.text: A stable musical note without vibrato, tremolo or rhythmic modulation.

top_matches.label: Rhythmic pulse
top_matches.text: A pulsing synthesizer sound with rhythmic volume modulation.

top_matches.label: Pitch vibrato
top_matches.text: A musical note with clear pitch vibrato wobbling up and down.

top_matches.label: Dry and close
top_matches.text: A dry close musical sound without reverb or echo.

top_matches.label: Delay echoes
top_matches.text: A musical note with distinct repeating delay echoes.

top_matches.label: Wide chorus
top_matches.text: A wide lush layered synthesizer with detuned chorus and stereo movement.

limitations: Similarity is relative, not a calibrated probability or a free-form caption.
Descriptors depend on the candidate bank. Use identical notes, velocity and recording conditions for A/B.
The model does not infer Falcon parameter values or automatically apply changes.

measurements.note: These are signal measurements, not LUFS or perceptual judgments.
